mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(user_openid) VALUES(#{openid}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT user_openid AS openid, nickname, avatar_url AS avatarUrl FROM users WHERE user_openid=#{openid} AND nickname IS NOT NULL AND nickname<>'' AND nickname<>'微信用户'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO users(user_openid,nickname,avatar_url) VALUES(#{openid},#{nickname},#{avatarUrl}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE nickname=VALUES(nickname), avatar_url=VALUES(avatar_url), updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
mapper.select: SELECT r.*, c.name category_name, (r.user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.user_openid=r.user_openid AND u.nickname IS NOT NULL AND u.nickname<>'' AND u.nickname<>'微信用户')) editable, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites f WHERE f.recipe_id=r.id AND f.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) favorited FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_categories c ON c.id=r.category_id AND (c.user_openid=#{userOpenid} OR c.user_openid IS NULL) WHERE r.user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recipe_favorites fav WHERE fav.recipe_id=r.id AND fav.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) AND c.name=#{categoryName} AND (r.title LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%') OR r.description LIKE CONCAT('%',#{keyword},'%')) ORDER BY r.updated_at DESC LIMIT #{offset},#{pageSize}
SELECT * FROM recipe_ingredients WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY sort_order,id
SELECT * FROM recipe_steps WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY step_no,id
SELECT * FROM recipe_images WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId} ORDER BY sort_order,id

SELECT r.*, c.name category_name, (r.user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users u WHERE u.user_openid=r.user_openid AND u.nickname IS NOT NULL AND u.nickname<>'' AND u.nickname<>'微信用户')) editable, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites f WHERE f.recipe_id=r.id AND f.user_openid=#{userOpenid}) favorited FROM recipes r LEFT JOIN recipe_categories c ON c.id=r.category_id AND (c.user_openid=#{userOpenid} OR c.user_openid IS NULL) WHERE r.id=#{id} AND r.user_openid=#{userOpenid}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipes WHERE id=#{id} AND user_openid=#{openid}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO recipes(user_openid,category_id,title,description,cover_url,difficulty,cooking_time,servings,is_public) VALUES(#{userOpenid},(SELECT id FROM recipe_categories WHERE name=#{categoryName} AND (user_openid=#{userOpenid} OR user_openid IS NULL) ORDER BY user_openid IS NULL LIMIT 1),#{title},#{description},#{coverUrl},#{difficulty},#{cookingTime},#{servings},#{isPublic})
mapper.update: UPDATE recipes SET category_id=(SELECT id FROM recipe_categories WHERE name=#{categoryName} AND (user_openid=#{userOpenid} OR user_openid IS NULL) ORDER BY user_openid IS NULL LIMIT 1), title=#{title}, difficulty=#{difficulty}, cooking_time=#{cookingTime}, updated_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE id=#{id} AND user_openid=#{userOpenid}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipes WHERE id=#{id} AND user_openid=#{userOpenid}
mapper.update: UPDATE cooking_records SET recipe_title=COALESCE(recipe_title,(SELECT title FROM recipes WHERE id=#{recipeId})), recipe_id=NULL WHERE recipe_id=#{recipeId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM recipe_favorites WHERE user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND recipe_id=#{recipeId}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM recipe_favorites WHERE user_openid=#{userOpenid} AND recipe_id=#{recipeId}
